usage: Repo should have a visible security policy
name: Repo should have a visible security policy
description: Repositories should have a Security Policy file present so that users of the repo are aware of how to responsibly disclose any security vulnerabilities that they find. This is especially true for public repositories.
detailedDescription: If no SECURITY.md file is included as part of a repository, then users may be discouraged to report vulnerabilities that they find in the code. This is typically not what you would want for public repositories.
